primary_title: The common gamma-chain is an indispensable subunit of the IL-21 receptor complex
decision_basis: Review-guided primary study supports IL-21R:IL2RG-complex-to-STAT1 activation in human receptor-reconstituted cells.
limitations_preserved: Preserve gamma-chain-dependent human reconstitution; no direct receptor-to-STAT1 biochemical claim, terminal-TF or SCI inference.

primary_title: The common gamma chain (gamma c) is a required signaling component of the IL-21 receptor and supports IL-21-induced cell proliferation via JAK3
decision_basis: Review-guided primary study supports IL-21R:IL2RG-complex-to-STAT5 activation in gamma-chain-restored lymphoid systems.
limitations_preserved: Preserve gamma-chain-restored lymphoid and species context; no direct receptor-to-STAT5 biochemical claim, terminal-TF or SCI inference.
